plans.name: Free
plans.requiredFor: Keyless read access for agents and point queries: up to 2,000 GET requests per day per IP (UTC day) on /api/v1/*, rate limited to 200 requests per minute per IP. No authentication.

plans.name: Metered (x402)
plans.requiredFor: Sustained reads beyond the free daily quota: $0.01 per request on Base, settled per-request via x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required). Metered responses carry X-Meter-Remaining and X-Meter-Reset headers.

mechanisms.description: No registration and no account: reads are keyless and anonymous at the free tier. Overage is settled per-request via x402 on Base, so there is no application to create and no credential to store.

economics.freeTier: Up to 2,000 GET requests per day per IP (UTC day) on /api/v1/*, 200 requests per minute per IP, no authentication.
